issues.summary: MultiSearchQuery.filter and .sort are typed as list[Any] — no type safety for query predicates
evidence: filter: list[Any] | None — Meilisearch filters can be strings, lists, or nested structures
sort: list[Any] | None — sort expressions are strings like 'nom:asc'
Passing a malformed filter (e.g., a nested dict instead of a filter string) is not caught by the type system
issues.suggestion: Define FilterClause = str | list[str | list] as a recursive type alias, or use a Union[str, list[FilterClause]] TypeAlias. At minimum, type sort as list[str] since Meilisearch sort expressions are always strings.

root_causes: complex Meilisearch filter syntax not fully expressible in Python type system
